change: Admit direct increase and delta beside rate in existing grouped SUM subquery completed-clock reuse.
admission: Same direct Matrix leaf, grouping/clock checks, complete Float-output/no-multiple-head proof and range-consumer ancestry; no blanket range-function expansion.
semantics: Original per-function kernels remain authoritative. Increase is not rewritten as rate times duration; delta retains negative-gauge and counter-reset distinctions. Full preparation owns diagnostics, including absent mixed-history outputs.
ownership: No new runtime fields, sample buffers, provider callbacks or caps. Newly admitted queries can now allocate the existing lazy interval and contributor metadata. Selected values and arithmetic remain fresh; completion and clearing are unchanged.

frozen_gates.slower_cases: Retain all; at most one6block1warm+6measured follow-up of cases>1.05, never a replacement gate.
frozen_gates.resources: Exact owned accounting; bounded raw paging; minor fixed costs under existing proportional policy.

start_timestamp_validation.initial_gap: The initial started history used server-default, disabling supplied start timestamps. Those cases remain disabled-feature controls.
start_timestamp_validation.correction: Separate upstream-tests cases explicitly disable delayed name removal, enabling start timestamps while admitting the optimized path.

limitations: Synthetic timings and query accounting do not establish live dbengine throughput or process RSS.
This is a narrow extension of existing grouped subquery reuse; unsupported shapes retain bounded replay.

Native release-min and both ARM targets are actual separate builds; QEMU checks establish finite execution correctness, not ARM throughput.
